Depending on the position, you need to dress for the role. Be sure to have a few extra copies of your resume and references in case the face to face person doesn't have it. Also, have copies of anything else you might need to bring with you.

Most importantly, whoever you are talking to make sure to look them right in the eyes. Don't look away.

Dress professional, act professional, talk professional and above all else, be honest. Honesty will help you and the company in the long run. If you are dishonest you might get a job you might not enjoy are you will suffer.

Firm handshake, look interviewer in the eye, be confident but not arrogant.

Show enthusiasm for the gig! Express you'll learn fast, and are dedicated to your job. Don't slouch, or talk bad about any past employer. They'll prob ask how you deal in certain situations; employee conflict, rude customer, something broke. Tell them something postive, AND HAVE SPECIFIC STORIES. Stories sell.
